game_title: Nested While Dungeon – Mine Cart Tunnel Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor. Each round, shadow wraiths strike the mine cart, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the dungeon_clear value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the mine cart from shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel: keep the dungeon_clear meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: dungeon_clear drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Nested While Dungeon
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how dungeon_clear changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while dungeon_clear > 0.
